bibliographic.title: Halloween Scarecrow II: Interview with a Scarecrow
bibliographic.author: Duncan Bowsman
bibliographic.description: You are a child wearing a scarecrow costume and carrying a receptacle with some candy in it. On a terrible Halloween night, after trick-or-treating, you go out camping with your mean, older sibling who tells a scary story about a scarecrow. That night, alone, you meet the scarecrow, and it tells you a horrible secret...
